page_title: MET 1-1 ANG | Metz v Angers 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Angers are ruled offside.
90+6' Angers are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
90+2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Metz.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 1 - 1 Goal! Himad Abdelli (Angers) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Jonathan Fischer.
90' Himad Abdelli (Angers) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
87' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Angers!
87' Referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
86' PENALTY APPEAL by Angers, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Stambouli leaves the pitch and Jessy Deminguet (Metz) comes on.
81' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
81' Some great controlled play and passing from Angers. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
80' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) replacing Lilian Raolisoa.
74' Jonathan Fischer (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' Prosper Peter (Angers) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
72' Substitution. Ibou Sane leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
72' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to substitute Georgiy Tsitaishvili and he is replaced by Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz).
72' That's the end of the game for Louis Mouton, who is replaced by Himad Abdelli (Angers).
70' Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

66' Terry Yegbe (Metz) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the bottom left corner, Herve Koffi didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
65' Shots on target – 4:1.
64' Habib Diallo (Metz) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
64' Habib Diallo (Metz) is going to take the penalty!
62' Herve Koffi (Angers) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. It's a penalty for Metz!
61' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Florent Hanin will be replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
61' A substitution has been made. Sidiki Cherif is replaced by Lanroy Machine (Angers).
60' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
59' Metz have a corner.
58' Some neat passing and movement from Angers as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
53' The ball goes behind for a corner. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Ibou Sane (Metz) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
46' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+5' Prosper Peter (Angers) blows a big chance to score! He slammed the ball from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
45+4' It's a throw-in for Angers.
45+2' Alpha Toure (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+2' Haris Belkebla (Angers) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' Prosper Peter (Angers) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jonathan Fischer anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
45' Jonathan Fischer (Metz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
39' Prosper Peter (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) brings an opponent down and Benoit Millot interrupts the game. Metz get a free kick.
33' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Metz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

28' Ibou Sane (Metz) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
28' The ball is behind the touchline and Metz will take a throw-in.
27' One of the Metz players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. That's a free kick to Angers.
23' A player from Metz brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
18' Angers are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
14' 1 - 0 Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom left corner.
14' The linesman makes the right call and Metz will have a corner.
13' Habib Diallo (Metz) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
11' The Metz players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
9' The ball is out of play. Metz will have a throw-in.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' Metz keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Metz will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benoit Millot.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
